summary:
ASTRA HEALTHGUARD is an autonomous, offline medical monitoring and life-support decision system designed for deep-space exploration. Built using official NASA physiological thresholds and embedded spaceflight datasets, our dashboard unifies 7 biometric and cabin sensors (heart rate, SpO₂, temperature, stress, solar radiation, O₂ levels, and cabin pressure) at a 1.5-second telemetry rate.

During deep-space missions, a round-trip communication delay of up to 20 minutes makes real-time medical support from Earth impossible. ASTRA HEALTHGUARD solves this by autonomously cross-analyzing sensor streams, classifying risks across four alert tiers, and delivering life-saving medical prescriptions in under one second without network dependency. It also features a 30-second cognitive assessment and one-click crisis simulations (EVA hypoxia, solar flares, depressurization), empowering crews to act decisively and survive when Earth is too far to help.

ASTRA HEALTHGUARD - Space Astronaut Health Monitoring Dashboard

A production-ready, futuristic React single-page application (SPA) for monitoring astronaut vitals, environmental factors, and generating real-time AI-driven health protocols during space missions.

**For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026**

## 🌌 Features

✅ **Real-Time Biometric Telemetry**

- Heart Rate, SpO₂, Core Temperature, and Stress Index monitoring

- Live Recharts line graphs showing 15-minute trend analysis

- Color-coded status indicators (Green/Yellow/Red)

✅ **Environmental Monitoring**

- Solar radiation detection and tracking

- Cabin oxygen concentration monitoring

- Pressure regulation status

- 10-minute radiation trend bar chart

✅ **Intelligent Health Rules Engine**

- Autonomous protocol generation based on physiological and environmental data

- 9 distinct medical protocols (URGENT-01 through WARN-09)

- Real-time alert classification (CRITICAL, DANGER, WARNING, NOMINAL)

- Smart recommendations for each condition

✅ **30-Second Cognitive Assessment**

- Behavioral self-evaluation module

- Mood, focus, fatigue, and anxiety tracking

- Cognitive fitness score (0-100)

- Mission readiness determination

✅ **Emergency Simulation**

- One-click emergency trigger for hackathon demonstrations

- Realistic emergency condition progression

- Critical metric drops (SpO₂ ~89%, HR ~140 BPM, Radiation spike)

- Visual emergency indicators and pulse animations

✅ **Base de Données Forcée & Edge Storage (NASA Datasets)**

- Persistance locale hors-ligne avec `localStorage`

- 6 Scénarios de télémétrie spatiale forcés (Nominale, Hypoxie EVA, Éruption Solaire, Décompression, Tachycardie, Sommeil)

- Base équipage (Roster astronautes : Thomas Pesquet, Sarah Vance, Alex Chen, Elena Rostova)

- Journalisation horodatée de télémétrie en mémoire

- Registre des alertes/incidents et archives des tests cognitifs

- Export JSON & réinitialisation de la base en 1 clic

✅ **Dark Space-Themed UI**

- Futuristic design inspired by NASA mission control

- Tailwind CSS with custom dark slate color palette

- Lucide React icons (Hospital Satellite, Alert, Heart, etc.)

- Glowing text effects for critical alerts

- Responsive grid layout (Mobile, Tablet, Desktop)

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |

|-------|-----------|

| **Frontend Framework** | React 18.3 |

| **Build Tool** | Vite 5.0 |

| **Styling** | Tailwind CSS 3.4 |

| **Charts & Visualization** | Recharts 2.10 |

| **Icons** | Lucide-react 0.263 |

| **Persistence / Mock DB** | Edge LocalStorage + Forced Database Engine |

| **State Management** | React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useCallback) |

## 📂 Project Structur

```

src/

├── components/

│ ├── Header.jsx # Mission status & emergency trigger button

│ ├── BiometricsCard.jsx # Heart Rate, SpO2, Stress, Temp + realtime chart

│ ├── EnvironmentCard.jsx # Radiation, Cabin O2, Pressure metrics

│ ├── ProtocolsPanel.jsx # Real-time protocol alerts & recommendations

│ ├── BehavioralPanel.jsx # 30-second cognitive assessment with DB storage

│ └── DatabaseModal.jsx # Explorateur & gestionnaire de Base de Données Forcée

├── services/

│ └── mockDatabase.js # Base de données forcée, équipage, télémétrie, persistance

├── hooks/

│ └── useVitalsStream.js # Flux télémétrique connecté à la base de données

├── utils/

│ └── healthRulesEngine.js # Health evaluation & alert generation

├── App.jsx # Main dashboard layout avec barre de scénarios

├── main.jsx # React DOM entry point

└── index.css # Tailwind directives & custom styles

Visit `http://localhost:5173` in your browser.

### 3. **Build for Production**

## 📊 Usage Guide

### Real-Time Dashboard

1. **Biometrics Card**: Watch live vital trends update every 1.5 seconds

2. **Environment Card**: Monitor cabin and external environment status

3. **Protocols Panel**: Review autonomous health recommendations based on current state

4. **Behavioral Panel**: Run 30-second cognitive assessment (optional)

### Emergency Simulation (Hackathon Demo)

1. Click **"TRIGGER SIMULATED EMERGENCY"** button in the header

2. Watch metrics plummet and critical alerts populate automatically

3. See the health rules engine generate urgent protocols

4. Click **"RESET NOMINAL"** to return to normal operation

### Alert Levels & Colors

- 🔴 **CRITICAL** (Red): Immediate life-threatening condition

- 🟠 **DANGER** (Orange): Severe emergency requiring immediate action

- 🟡 **WARNING** (Yellow): Caution - monitor closely and prepare protocols

- 🟢 **NOMINAL** (Green): All systems optimal - continue mission

## 🧠 Health Rules Engine Reference

| Metric | Condition | Trigger | Protocol |

|--------|-----------|---------|----------|

| SpO₂ | < 93% | CRITICAL Hypoxia | URGENT-01: Increase FiO₂ to 100% |

| HR + Stress | > 120 BPM + > 70 Index | WARNING | STRESS-03: 4-7-8 Box Breathing |

| Heart Rate | > 130 BPM | DANGER Tachycardia | DANGER-04: Emergency Return Procedures |

| Radiation | > 0.8 Sv/h | DANGER Spike | RAD-05: Execute Shelter Protocol |

| Radiation | 0.5-0.8 Sv/h | WARNING | WARN-06: Stay in Shielded Areas |

| Cabin Pressure | Out of 95-105 kPa | WARNING | PRESS-07: Check Regulation System |

| Cabin O₂ | Out of 19-21% | WARNING | O2-08: Activate Replenishment |

| Body Temp | Out of 36.5-38.5°C | WARNING | TEMP-09: Adjust Thermal Regulation |

## 🎮 Custom Hooks

### `useVitalsStream()`

Simulates real-time physiological data feed with emergency injection.

**Returns:**

```javascript

{

vitals: { heartRate, spo2, bodyTemp, stressIndex },

env: { radiation, cabinO2, cabinPressure },

history: [{ ...vitals, ...env, timestamp }, ...],

isEmergency: boolean,

toggleEmergency: () => void,

resetToNormal: () => void,

}

```

**Update Rate:** 1.5 seconds per record

**History Window:** Last 15 records (~22.5 minutes)

## 📋 Health Rules Engine Functions

### `evaluateVitals(vitals, env)`

Analyzes physiological and environmental data to generate alerts.

**Input:**

```javascript

vitals: { heartRate, spo2, bodyTemp, stressIndex }

env: { radiation, cabinO2, cabinPressure }

```

**Output:**

```javascript

{

status: 'CRITICAL' | 'DANGER' | 'WARNING' | 'NOMINAL',

alerts: [

{

level,

title,

description,

recommendation,

metric,

icon

}

],

recommendations: [...]

}

```

### `getAlertColor(level)`

Returns CSS color classes for alert styling.

## 🎨 Tailwind CSS Dark Theme

- **Background**: `bg-slate-950`, `bg-slate-900`

- **Text**: `text-slate-100`, `text-slate-300`

- **Borders**: `border-slate-800`, `border-slate-700`

- **Status Colors**:

- Critical: `text-red-400`, `border-red-500`

- Warning: `text-yellow-400`, `border-yellow-500`

- Nominal: `text-green-400`, `border-green-500`

**Custom Animations:**

- `.glow-critical`, `.glow-warning`, `.glow-nominal`: Glowing text effects

- `.pulse-glow`: Emergency indicator animation

- `.card-hover`: Smooth card hover transitions

## 🚨 Emergency Simulation Logic

When emergency is triggered:

1. **SpO₂** drops to ~89% (critical hypoxia)

2. **Heart Rate** spikes to ~140 BPM (severe tachycardia)

3. **Stress Index** rises to 85+ (maximum stress)

4. **Radiation** jumps to 0.95+ Sv/h (solar spike)

5. **Body Temp** rises to 38.5°C (fever)

6. **Cabin O₂** drops to 17.5% (low oxygen)

All metrics continue to vary realistically while in emergency mode.

## 📖 NASA Space Apps Challenge Context

This dashboard demonstrates a complete, production-grade solution for **real-time astronaut health monitoring** on long-duration space missions. It addresses critical needs:

1. **Autonomous Monitoring**: Reduces manual health check burden on astronauts

2. **Edge Computing**: Works offline in isolated space environments

3. **Intelligent Alerting**: AI-driven protocols for quick decision-making

4. **Behavioral Integration**: Cognitive assessment alongside biometrics

5. **Hackathon-Ready**: Emergency simulation for live demonstrations
